title: ARC-AGI-3 causal reasoning trace
entry_trigger: User requested a new target that would be externally impressive to trace after pinning GEMS.
preferred_referent: 📍 ARC3-TRACE-001 — witness compression from supported within-environment correspondences
goal: Measure whether A/B-constrained forward matching can increase relations-resolved per ARC3 environment action by reusing only locally witnessed mechanics across explicitly supported corresponding contexts.
definition_of_solved_for_first_trace: Every admitted rule is tied to an observable state transition or replay witness.
Failed hypotheses remain preserved rather than silently rewritten.
The inferred goal is distinguished from the mechanics used to reach it.
A compact world model predicts at least one later state transition before it is observed.
The final trace explains a successful or meaningfully advancing action sequence without relying on hidden instructions.
The output can be presented unchanged as input to the same trace contract on another public environment.
